chunks: Ahmad ibn al-Hasan al-Attar narrated to us, he said: Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Hatim narrated to us, he said: al-Hajjaj ibn Hamzah narrated to us, he said: Yazid narrated to us, he said: Sadaqah al-Rafiqi informed me, he said: Thabit narrated to us from Anas, he said:
The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) was asked: Which fasting is the most superior? He said: Fasting in Sha'ban, to honor Ramadan.

key_terms.شَعْبَان: Sha'ban (the eighth month of the Islamic calendar)

ai.seo_question: What is the most superior fast according to the Prophet?
ai.summary: In this narration from Shaykh al-Saduq, the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) identifies fasting in Sha'ban as the most superior act, explicitly linking its virtue to the honor it confers upon the upcoming month of Ramadan. This practice is historically viewed by Shia scholars as a spiritual preparation (isti'dad) that bridges the gap between the minor fasts of the year and the obligatory fasts of Ramadan, reflecting the Prophet's consistent devotion during this month.
